action_items: No defects. Per main-agent guidance, true 301 redirects aren't possible for SPA static hosting — the implemented client-redirect + <link rel=canonical> + vanity sitemap combo is the correct equivalent and is verified working. Not a bug.
Pre-existing '-83 listings' hero display quirk was noted in the review-request context but wasn't in scope for this iter460 test; ignored.
critical_code_review_comments: custom_url.py _collision (L123-133): correctly checks THREE namespaces — canonical slugs, live custom_url, previous_slugs — with own_slug carve-outs on the vanity+previous checks so a maker can reclaim their own retired vanity. Order matters: slug collision first (cheapest, most likely), then live vanity, then previous_slugs. Tight.

custom_url.py _apply_change (L136-153): uses a single update_one with $set + conditional $pull to drop the incoming candidate from previous_slugs, then a SECOND update_one to $addToSet the old value. Two writes because Mongo won't let you $pull and $addToSet on the same array in one op. Idempotent on repeat-POST (same value → old==cand → no history push). Solid.

custom_url.py _validate_format (L94-109): reserved-word check runs AFTER regex/length so we get a helpful 'reserved by platform' message instead of a generic format error for e.g. 'admin'. Ordering matters for UX; correct here.

catalog.py get_maker (L625-638): three-way resolution — custom_url first (canonical), then slug, then previous_slugs. Order guarantees a maker's vanity URL always wins even if a legacy slug shares the string. Correct precedence.

seo.py sitemap (L251-261, 273-286): uses maker.custom_url when present, falls back to slug. Section URLs (L276-286) also correctly use pub_of[maker_slug] so section deep links inherit the vanity address. This is where a lot of teams would silently leak both URLs — nice catch here.

MakerDetail.jsx client-redirect + canonical: since static hosting can't do true 301, the resolve-first effect + <Navigate replace> combo is the pragmatic SPA equivalent. Canonical tag ensures Google collapses duplicates into the vanity URL over time.

CustomUrlPicker.jsx (L9-13, L62 LockedCard): the class docstring still says 'Plus-only' and the component still has `if (locked) return <LockedCard/>` on 403 — this is dead code post-iter460 because the backend no longer 403s the endpoint. Not a bug, just stale documentation + an unreachable branch. Consider dropping the LockedCard fallback + updating the JSDoc block for clarity.

ApprovedMakersTab.jsx VanityUrlEditor (L15-57): inline editor is tight — client-side normalizes input to [a-z0-9-] on every keystroke so the input never contains a value the backend would reject. History line only renders when previous_slugs is non-empty. Good UX.

custom_url.py resolve_maker (L245-272): returns matched_via='custom_url' | 'slug' | 'previous' so the client can decide whether to redirect. For matched_via=='slug' it still sets public_slug to custom_url if the maker HAS one — so hitting the internal slug still redirects to the vanity. Elegant.

rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Every review-request bullet passed on first execution.
